entities.summary: Sayed Muhammad Gulabzoi is an Afghan former military officer and politician. He was a prominent political figure in the government of the Democratic Republic of Afghanistan, and played a notable role in the Saur Revolution that placed the People's Democratic Party of Afghanistan (PDPA) in power and installed a communist government in Afghanistan. Gulabzoi was also one of the leaders of PDPA's Khalq faction.
